_ayuda: Single source of truth for the game. To add content: create a sprite in 'sprites' (with its PixelLab prompt) and reference it from an item, object, or crop. Then run: node herramientas/generar-assets.mjs (only generates what is missing).
_estilo: Art bible: design/biblia-de-arte.md. One style for every character and creature: the slime's (cute chibi, round, soft). 'personajes' applies to playable characters and future residents.

mazmorras.descripcion: Damp old shafts under the ridge. Copper, iron, hungry slimes, and an ancient stone colossus below.

_monstruos: health, damage (half heart = 1), speed in px/s, vision in tiles. 'suelta': item → [probability, min, max].

monstruos.descripcion: A damp jelly blob with more appetite than malice.
Flutters nervously whenever someone lights a torch nearby.
Forgot his shift in the tunnel ended a hundred years ago.
A gelatinous monarch that swallowed the key to the Forgotten Crypt.
A moss-covered colossus guarding the mother lode since Grandpa's days.
A cold sigh drifting through stone in search of lantern light.
Tried to bottle up spring in clay urns and became prisoner to his own shadows.
The first warden of Mosslantern Glen, forever testing those who delve below.

Chops trees, clears weeds, and picks up placed objects.
Breaks boulders and ore veins. Essential beneath the cliff.

6 days of care, but each pumpkin is worth its weight in copper.
Crisp and peppery. Eat it raw for a quick energy boost.
Smells like fresh damp earth. Sells well or makes a hearty snack.
The pride of Mosslantern Glen. Turned into preserves, it fetches a small fortune.
Radishes pickled with glen herbs. Crunchy the moment you pop the lid.
Sweet and bright like late afternoon sun.
Aurelius's secret recipe. Folks across the glen bid high for every jar.
Sturdy glen oak, fragrant with fresh resin.
Grey cliff stone, solid enough for furnaces and sprinklers.
Tough dry stalks; useful for tying almost anything together.
Stores up to 12 items. A tidy farm brings peace of mind.

Waters the 4 adjacent cardinal tiles every morning.

Turns a raw crop into artisan preserves in 20 hours.
Wearing Grandpa's old hat: keeps crows away within an 8-tile radius.
Smelts 3 raw ores into a gleaming ingot in a few hours.
Warm flame that pushes back the dark on the farm and in dungeons.
Comfy moss-green overalls: tilling and watering use half the energy.

Rock streaked with warm orange copper. Smelt 3 in a furnace for an ingot.
Dense metal from the deeper shafts. Needs a hot furnace.
Home-smelted copper bar, ready for forging blades or mining gear.
Heavy pure iron bar. The pride of any glen forge.
'Mosslantern Crystal'. Blue subterranean crystal that glows like a lantern in the dark.
Sticky, but mixed with radish it brews into a wonderful healing tonic.
Light as night air, ideal for lining sturdy adventurer armor.
Mineral-soaked bone fragment; reinforces iron blades and cuirasses.

_botines: Loot tables for dungeons. Each player rolls their own instanced loot.
_historia: Mosslantern Glen flavor, dynamic lines from Brisa at the stall, and Grandpa Aurelius's craft notes. Endless day-to-day farming, crafting, and dungeon runs.

historia.lema_portada: Your cozy corner in Mosslantern Glen: farm day by day, craft preserves, smelt ore, and delve into endless shifting dungeons.

saludos.inicio: "Aurelius always said the soil listens. Grab some radish seeds—they sprout fast and forgive mistakes."
saludos.lluvia: "Rainy day, easy day. Let the clouds water the fields while you head underground to mine."
saludos.hito_1: "Smells like furnace smoke and fresh earth. You've got your grandpa's hands already."
saludos.hito_conserva: "Is that sweet spice in the air? Nothing beats a fresh jar of Mosslantern preserves on a cool evening."
saludos.hito_2: "The cliff rumbled last night... So you unsealed the Forgotten Crypt. Bring pumpkins and good iron."
saludos.hito_3: "Word is you conquered the bottom of the mine. Every time you return, the mountain grows richer and tougher."
saludos.hito_linterna: "Look at that blue crystal glow on your gear! True Mosslantern craftsmanship, just like Aurelius used to forge."
saludos.hito_4: "The mist in the tunnel shifts every day. Long as you have furnaces and potions, the loot never runs dry."
saludos.hito_final: "You crossed blades with the Spectral Knight, yet the Crypt never truly sleeps—each run holds more gems and greater challenges."

charlas: "Why is it called Mosslantern Glen? Step out near the northern cliff at dusk—the damp moss feeds on crystal dust from the caves and glows like little blue lanterns."
"Your Grandpa Aurelius never believed in 'finishing' a farm. He'd say a farm is like a good hearth fire: you tend it every morning, and it warms you every night."
"If you ever put something in the shipping bin by mistake, just interact with it empty-handed before you go to sleep to take it back."
"Merchants from across the ridge pay triple for Golden Pumpkin Jam. Keep a row of Preserves Jars busy and you'll never want for gold."
"The tunnels under the cliff shift their halls every time a delver clears the tenth floor. Deeper runs mean fiercer monsters, but the treasure chests overflow."
"Never head into the Forgotten Crypt without a stack of Health Potions. Three Slime Gels and one fresh Radish—simple, sharp, and life-saving!"

murmullos: ✨ Blue moss lanterns along the cliff trail faded softly into the morning mist.
🌿 A cool breeze carries the scent of damp oak and wild clover across Mosslantern Glen.
⛏️ Faint echoes ring from the Copper Mine entrance; the mountain veins feel restless today.
🍯 Aunt Brisa is humming an old glen tune while arranging seed packets at her stall.
💧 Dew glistens on the farmhouse roof—a peaceful morning for tending furrows or stoking furnaces.
🕯️ The lantern crystals beneath the ridge pulsed with a quiet azure hum before sunrise.
🦉 An owl glided over the pond at dawn, leaving the glen calm and bright.

cartas.resumen: Note 1 · The Rhythm of Mosslantern Glen
cartas.texto: If you're reading this, I've hung up my hoe and the farm is yours. There's no rush or finish line here—each morning you decide whether to plant, fire up the furnaces, or delve into the cliff tunnel. I left you tools, radish seeds, and Aunt Brisa's stall right next door.

cartas.resumen: Note 2 · First Harvest or First Smelted Ingot
cartas.texto: A fresh root pulled from the soil or a warm ingot from the furnace—that's the heart of the craft. The more you automate your fields with sprinklers and preserves jars, the more time and supplies you'll have to mine rare ores below.

cartas.resumen: Note 3 · Collected Your First Artisan Preserve
cartas.texto: There's magic in patience. A single pumpkin or radish sealed in a wooden keg with glen herbs turns into a delicacy that funds entire expeditions. Line up several jars by the farmhouse and let time work for you.

cartas.resumen: Note 4 · Defeated the Slime King & Opened the Crypt
cartas.texto: Found the passage behind that crowned jelly, did you? You can now enter the Forgotten Crypt from the cave entrance. Its halls shift on every run, and it's where iron and blue lantern gems are most abundant for your best recipes.

cartas.resumen: Note 5 · Cleared Floor 10 of the Copper Mine
cartas.texto: The Stone Guardian watches over the mother lode, and the mountain is alive: every time you clear the mine and return, its denizens grow tougher and its chests roll extra loot. It's always worth diving back in.
When you set a Lantern Gem into iron, it remembers the underground spring. A Lantern Sprinkler waters an entire 3×3 plot every dawn, and a Lanternblade cuts through crypt shadows like morning light.

cartas.resumen: Note 7 · Cleared Floor 5 of the Forgotten Crypt
cartas.texto: The Necromancer rearranges the Crypt walls on every expedition. Use the Floor 6 checkpoint whenever you want to drop straight into the deep gem veins to craft lantern-infused gear.

cartas.resumen: Note 8 · Bested the Spectral Knight (Crypt Mastery)
cartas.texto: Few have ever crossed blades with the Spectral Knight and walked back out. In Mosslantern Glen the adventure never ends—each victory awakens stronger foes and richer treasure to keep growing your farm day after day.
